title: Unlock Expressive Typography: Master CSS 'font-variation-settings' for Dynamic Web Font UI & UX
tweet: Go beyond basic weights! Master CSS 'font-variation-settings' to dynamically control #VariableFonts axes like weight, width, & optical size. Elevate your #UITypography for superior #UX with fewer requests. #CSS #WebFonts
tip: Variable fonts offer unparalleled typographic control, but many developers only use their preset weights. Dive deeper with the 'font-variation-settings' CSS property to precisely adjust individual font axes like weight ('wght'), width ('wdth'), optical size ('opsz'), or even custom axes specific to a font. This allows for nuanced design adaptations, like subtle adjustments for different screen sizes or dark modes, without loading multiple font files. It dramatically improves UI flexibility and performance, leading to a richer user experience with fewer network requests.
